standard_prerequisites.use: Makes finitely presented modules pure projective, shows the constructed sequence is universally exact, and turns splitting into pure projectivity.

core_obligations: Show finitely presented modules are pure projective, hence so are direct summands of direct sums of them (proof lines 2694-2697).
Write M as a filtered colimit of finitely presented modules and form the displayed sequence (proof lines 2697-2702).
Show every map from a finitely presented module to M factors through some P_i, so the sequence is universally exact (proof lines 2703-2708).
Conclude the pure projective case by splitting the sequence (proof lines 2709-2710).
proof_roadmap: Finitely presented modules are pure projective (proof lines 2694-2697).
The pure projective case by splitting (proof lines 2709-2710).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that a module is pure projective exactly when it is a direct summand of a direct sum of finitely presented modules, and that every module fits into a universally exact sequence 0 -> N -> P -> M -> 0 with P pure projective (statement lines 2682-2691). The proof first notes that finitely presented modules are pure projective by the universal-exactness criterion, so direct summands of direct sums of them are pure projective; for the second part it writes M as a filtered colimit of finitely presented modules, forms the sequence 0 -> N -> the direct sum of the P_i -> M -> 0, observes that every map from a finitely presented module to M factors through some P_i, applies the universal-exactness criterion to conclude the sequence is universally exact, and finally derives the first part in the pure projective case by splitting (proof lines 2693-2710). The level is H3: both assertions are argued from the same displayed sequence, with the filtered-colimit factoring step and the splitting written out.
